metadata.title: The ELM Survey. II. Twelve Binary White Dwarf Merger Systems

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies ELM white dwarfs and binary merger systems, and does not identify any star as a present-day Galactic unbound candidate. The “Hypervelocity Star survey” reference at T:p2-b4 is parent-sample provenance, while the kinematic descriptions at T:p7-b3, T:p8-b1, T:p8-b3, and T:p9-b5 call the stars disk or halo members rather than Galactic unbound objects.
